issues.description: The Farm.singFarmSong() method has a return type mismatch across artifacts. The UML in the problem statement and the template implementation declare singFarmSong() as void, whereas the solution implementation returns a String. This inconsistency affects how students should implement the method (printing vs. returning the song) and may cause confusion or failing tests depending on which signature is expected.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent in all artifacts. Either (A) change the solution to public void singFarmSong() and have it print the song (matching the UML and template), or (B) update the problem statement UML and template to specify singFarmSong():String and adapt the template to return the assembled song string. Prefer option A to preserve the original UML and template intent (printing behavior).

issues.description: The private helper singFarmSongVerse has inconsistent signature and return type across artifacts. The UML and template indicate a private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal) (the template currently has the parameter commented out), while the solution implements private String singFarmSongVerse(Animal). This inconsistency changes whether the verse is printed directly or returned as a String and also whether the template's commented parameter must be added, potentially confusing students about the expected helper behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the helper method across artifacts. Either (A) change the solution's singFarmSongVerse to private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal) and have it perform printing (matching the UML/template), and uncomment/add the Animal parameter in the template stub; or (B) update the problem statement and template to expect a private String singFarmSongVerse(Animal) that returns the verse and document that singFarmSong() should concatenate and/or print the returned strings. Prefer option A to remain consistent with the UML and the template's printing-oriented design.
